definitions: To support or actively encourage; further the progress of something.
To raise or advance to a higher position or rank.
To publicize a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.
To move a pawn to the eighth rank, whereupon it is exchanged for the player's choice of a queen, rook, bishop, or knight of the same color.
examples: The organization works to promote peace.
She was promoted to senior manager.
They hired a firm to promote their new album.
He decided to promote his pawn to a queen.
